entry.title: 你的密码毫无作用-多款中兴微设备后门大起底(一)
entry.content:
​ 长期以来，使用中兴微ZX297520V3芯片的4G 随身Wifi设备一直因为性能较高，价格低廉而受追捧。然而，如果您使用的不是中兴所生产的设备，而是以下厂商所生产的，那么您的后台登录密码无论有没有修改，都将形同虚设。甚至对于某些设备，还可以执行任意指令。

1.ALK/QRZL设备

设备描述

这类设备的制造商比较复杂，设备自己和IMEI报的大部分都是ALK(深圳市阿乐卡科技有限公司)，然而写的型号和制造商千奇百怪，比如UG902(东莞市瑞联祥通科技有限公司)，MZ391(深圳市阿乐卡科技有限公司)，D623+(深圳市信丰智联科技有限公司)，SCM02(深圳市世创信科技有限公司)等，型号非常多且难以统计。
据称该设备的硬件方案商为易联科技（深圳）有限公司，而最大订货方以及后期众多设备的软件方案商为深圳市启瑞智联科技有限公司，我们将这类设备分为两类，一类向电脑报告为ALK,Incorporated ALK Mobile Boardband，分类为ALK设备，另一类向电脑报告为DEMO,Incorporated DEMO Mobile Boardband，分类为QRZL设备。

逆向设备信息

ALK系列

逆向设备:信翼(SineLink)D623+(深圳市信丰智联科技有限公司)
版本号:AM300LT1.0_BA_LX_SL_V01.01.02P42U17_04

后门信息

在ALK设备中，存在一系列以ALK_开头，无需登录的调试指令。

其中ALK_LOGIN端点可以在未登录状态下直接改写登录态为已登录，而ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD可以直接执行任意shell命令，由于中兴微设备是单用户架构，因此命令执行权限为root。
而QRZL设备为了防止用户去掉云控机制，去掉了大部分调试指令，但是仍保留ALK_LOGIN这个，可能是为了方便工厂调试。

详细证据

goform表

直接通过授权白名单，处理函数sub_15724的伪代码如下

对照登录态判定函数sub_1B360（被 set/get 两个入口调用）

设置的loginfo和i_alk_login都可以使设备登录态变为ok，即无密码授权

关于ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD端点，处理函数sub_155C8

执行器 sub_15564直接调用system()

无任何前置条件与黑名单。

简易PoC

ALK_LOGIN:http://<设备后台>/reqproc/proc_post?goformId=ALK_LOGIN
访问完设备后台登录了就是有影响
ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD:http://<设备后台>/reqproc/proc_post?goformId=ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD&SYS_CMD=reboot
访问完设备重启了就是有影响

受影响板号

包括但不限于AM206，AM231，AM300，AP100，M603，M605，MZ801，MZ803，MZ804，MZ805，MZ901，LKS-L007，LKS-L008，DZ801，DZ803，DZ805，UZ901，MF782T，MF783的各类ALK/QRZL设备

证明

2.SZXF设备

这类设备由深圳市信丰伟业科技有限公司生产，出售范围包括境内和海外，随身Wifi界被称为”天花板”的MF761W和F231ZC，M23L就是他们的产品。

entry.title: Your Password Is Useless-Backdoors in Multiple Sanechips-Based Devices (Part 1)
entry.content:
Your Password Is Useless-Backdoors in Multiple Sanechips-Based Devices (Part 1)

4G portable Wi-Fi (MiFi) devices built on the Sanechips ZX297520V3 SoC have long been popular for their relatively high performance and low price. However, if your device was not manufactured by ZTE itself but by one of the vendors below, your admin login password is meaningless whether or not you have ever changed it. On some devices, an attacker can even execute arbitrary commands.

1. ALK/QRZL devices

Device description

The manufacturers of these devices are complicated. Most devices and their IMEIs identify themselves as ALK (深圳市阿乐卡科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Aleka Technology Co., Ltd.), yet the model names and manufacturers printed on them vary widely, for example: UG902 (东莞市瑞联祥通科技有限公司 / Dongguan Ruilian Xiangtong Technology Co., Ltd.), MZ391 (Shenzhen Aleka Technology Co., Ltd.), D623+ (深圳市信丰智联科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Xinfeng Zhilian Technology Co., Ltd.), SCM02 (深圳市世创信科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Shichuang Xin Technology Co., Ltd.). There are many such models and they are difficult to enumerate.

It is said that the hardware design house for these devices is 易联科技（深圳）有限公司 / eLink Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Limited, while the largest purchaser and the software solution provider for many later devices is 深圳市启瑞智联科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Qirui Zhilian Technology Co., Ltd. We divide these devices into two categories: devices that enumerate to a PC as “ALK,Incorporated ALK Mobile Boardband” are classified as ALK devices; devices that enumerate as “DEMO,Incorporated DEMO Mobile Boardband” are classified as QRZL devices.

Reverse-engineering target information

ALK series

Device reverse-engineered: 信翼 (SineLink) D623+ (深圳市信丰智联科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Xinfeng Zhilian Technology Co., Ltd.)
Firmware version: AM300LT1.0_BA_LX_SL_V01.01.02P42U17_04
Verification device 1: UG902 (东莞市瑞联祥通科技有限公司 / Dongguan Ruilian Xiangtong Technology Co., Ltd.)
Firmware version: UZ901D2.1_B9_QR_DL_V01.01.02P42U17_03
Verification device 2: 聚小电 SCM02 (深圳市世创信科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Shichuangxin Technology Co., Ltd.)
Firmware version: M603TW2.6_R31BC_QC_ZX605_SL_QS_V01.01.02P42U17_01
Verification device 3: 阿乐卡 MZ391 (深圳市阿乐卡科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Aleka Technology Co., Ltd.)
Firmware version: AM206DW1.0_MZ391_BC_FL_SL_V01.01.02P42U28_03
Additional verification devices: many models; only firmware versions are listed.
Additional verification method: search for ALK_LOGIN with HxD; if a goformId and a handler are present, the device is affected.

MZ804LS1.0_KSBC_JIJIA_SL_V2.01.01.02P42U28P1_04-2507011

Backdoor details

ALK devices expose a set of ALK_-prefixed debug commands that require no authentication.

The ALK_LOGIN endpoint rewrites the login state to “logged in” without authentication, and ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD executes arbitrary shell commands. Because these Sanechips devices use a single-user architecture, such commands run with root privileges. To prevent users from disabling the cloud-control mechanism, QRZL devices remove most of the debug commands but still retain ALK_LOGIN, presumably for factory debugging.

Detailed evidence

goform table

The handler sub_15724 is reached directly through the authorization whitelist. Its pseudocode is as follows:

For comparison, the login-state check function sub_1B360 (called by both the set and get entry points):

Both the stored loginfo value and the i_alk_login flag can make the device report a login state of ok, i.e., passwordless authorization.

Regarding the ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD endpoint, the handler is sub_155C8:

The executor sub_15564 calls system() directly:

There are no preconditions and no blacklist.

Simple PoC

ALK_LOGIN: http://<device-admin-panel>/reqproc/proc_post?goformId=ALK_LOGIN
If the admin panel becomes logged in after the request, the device is affected.

ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD: http://<device-admin-panel>/reqproc/proc_post?goformId=ALK_EXC_SYSTEM_CMD&SYS_CMD=reboot
If the device reboots after the request, it is affected.

Affected board numbers

Including but not limited to various ALK/QRZL devices with board numbers AM206, AM231, AM300, AP100, M603, M605, MZ801, MZ803, MZ804, MZ805, MZ901, LKS-L007, LKS-L008, DZ801, DZ803, DZ805, UZ901, MF782T, MF783.

Proof

2. SZXF devices

These devices are produced by 深圳市信丰伟业科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Signalinks technology Co., Ltd. and are sold both domestically and overseas. Their products include the MF761W, F231ZC and M23L, which are regarded as the “ceiling” (top tier) of the portable Wi-Fi market.

entry.title: Your Password Is Useless-Backdoors in Multiple Sanechips-Based Devices (Part 2)
entry.content:
(Continued from Part 1)

2. SZXF devices

These devices are produced by 深圳市信丰伟业科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Signalinks technology Co., Ltd. and are sold both domestically and overseas. Their products include the MF761W, F231ZC and M23L, which are regarded as the “ceiling” (top tier) of the portable Wi-Fi market. Most units are manufactured by Shenzhen Signalinks technology Co., Ltd. under the D623 or MF782 model names; a few customized variants are not.

Reverse-engineering target information

Device reverse-engineered: Qmall (全猫上网) MF782
Firmware version: MF761W_V1.1_OM20_QX_JRAK1_2ESC_C19P002
Verification device 1: ASUS adol MF782
Firmware version: MF761W_V1.1_OM20_QX_SOUB2_3ES3C_C19P008
Verification device 2: xkbox MF782
Firmware version: XFNJ_P42_U05_MF761W_V1.1_OM_QX_HZKD_3ES_P001
Verification device 3: Freeworks (中沃) D623
Firmware version: XFNJ_B03P18_F231CE_V3.0_SM_FX_ZWXP_M_P004
Additional verification devices: many models; only firmware versions are listed.
Additional verification method: search for TMxfnj1234 with HxD; if it is present, the device is affected.

XFNJ_P33_01_MF782V_V1.1_RR_HS_MF782V_EM3_P003
XFNJ_P38_U01_MF761C_V1.1_NA_OM_ZWXSS4_EM3_P001
MF761W_V1.1_OM20_LX_YPWLQL_2ESC_C19P004
M23L_V1.2_XP_FM_DLXG_3ES3C_C19P001
M23L_V1.1_XP_FM_YTJY2_2ESC_C19P001

Backdoor details

In the goahead password verification function sub_FC9C, the supplied password is first compared with xfnj1234 before the real verification takes place.

The same logic is present in sub_13FE4.

Simple PoC

Simply enter xfnj1234 in the admin login password field. For a more advanced approach:
http://<device-admin-panel>/goform/goform_set_cmd_process?isTest=false&goformId=LOGIN&password=eGZuajEyMzQ%3D

Affected models

Mainly the MF782 and D623. Other models based on Signalinks solution are likely affected as well, including the various variants of the F231 and F232, as well as the MF782, MF761, M23L, M24L, M900 and U090.

Proof

3. LC devices

LC devices cover many brands, such as KuWfi and Wantang (万唐), plus many unbranded ones. Model numbers may be LM321, LC112, GW522, etc. Most units encountered are CPE devices, but there are also MiFi/UFi products.
The manufacturer may be 深圳市米饭儿数据科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Mifidata Technology Co., Ltd. (https://www.mifidata.com/).

Reverse-engineering target information

Device reverse-engineered: unbranded, board number LC113_UFI_V1.1
Firmware version: LC213_V6.0_V3TP42NOR_B40_EN_20260328
Verification device 1: Wantang GW522 (深圳市米饭儿数据科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Mifidata Technology Co., Ltd.)
Firmware version: LC213_V1.0_V3TP42NOR_B40_EN_20251018
Verification device 2: unbranded, board number LC113_UFI_V1.1
Firmware version: LC113_V4.1_V3TP42NOR_SH_SUPER_20240803

Backdoor details

In the LOGIN handler sub_13D04, after the password passes the length and failure-count checks in sub_13C18, it is first passed to sub_10BCC.

sub_10BCC checks whether the password equals the last four digits of the IMEI.

If it matches, the password is treated as correct and login succeeds directly.

During verification, this feature appears to have been intended by the vendor for entering a hidden eSIM switching page. The problem is that this check is purely client-side; therefore, after logging in with the last four digits of the IMEI, the actual privilege level is admin — the same as visiting the main page directly. This is even more outrageous than Tenda’s rzadmin, so to speak.
Most critically, the IMEI retrieval endpoint is unauthenticated (it is on the whitelist) — the IMEI is even displayed on the home page.

Simple PoC

Just read the IMEI on the home page and enter it in the login box, then log in and re-enter the panel.
For a more advanced approach:
http://<device-admin-panel>/reqproc/proc_get?isTest=false&cmd=imei
then
http://<device-admin-panel>/reqproc/proc_post?isTest=false&goformId=LOGIN&password=<base64 of the last four IMEI digits>

Affected board numbers

Including but not limited to various LC devices such as the LC113 and LC213.

Proof

Summary

Perhaps because MiFi/CPE admin panels are inherently unlikely to be reachable from the outside, these vendors did not remove these backdoors from production devices. Users are advised to use at least WPA2 encryption together with a strong password, to prevent their devices from being exploited by attackers.

在LOGIN的处理函数sub_13D04中，密码在经过sub_13C18检验长度和错误次数后，先经过sub_10BCC

而sub_10BCC的作用是比较密码是不是imei最后四位

简易PoC

直接首页看了IMEI往登录框填就行，填完登录重新进
高端一点就是http://<设备后台>/reqproc/proc_get?isTest=false&cmd=imei
然后http://<设备后台>/reqproc/proc_post?isTest=false&goformId=LOGIN&password=<IMEI后四位的base64>

受影响板号

包括但不限于LC113，LC213等各类LC设备

证明

总结

也许是因为Mifi/CPE设备后台天生不太可能被从外部访问，这些厂商并没有在量产机中去除这些后门，建议各位用户还是尽可能使用WPA2以上加密方式+强密码，以防设备遭受黑客的利用。
